mapper.select: -- 한 SQL 스냅샷에서 고유 기록 수만 집계한다. 원문/해시/반복 횟수는 반환하지 않는다. -- 최근 연결 실행의 용도만 사용하며 QA와 연결이 없는 과거 기록을 운영 수로 추정하지 않는다. WITH retained AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT t.provider_code, CASE WHEN t.semantic_reason_code IN ('TITLE_GROUP_B_MATCHED','TITLE_COMBINATION_NOT_MATCHED') THEN t.semantic_reason_code ELSE 'OTHER_LEGACY' END AS reason_code, coalesce(q.data_purpose_code, 'UNKNOWN') AS purpose FROM announcement_source_exclusion_tombstones t LEFT JOIN announcement_source_collection_runs r ON r.id=t.run_id LEFT JOIN announcement_source_collection_requests q ON q.id=r.request_id ), counts AS ( SELECT 'PURPOSE'::text AS dimension, purpose AS code, count(1) AS count FROM retained GROUP BY purpose UNION ALL SELECT 'PROVIDER', provider_code, count(1) FROM retained WHERE purpose='PRODUCTION' GROUP BY provider_code UNION ALL SELECT 'REASON', reason_code, count(1) FROM retained WHERE purpose='PRODUCTION' GROUP BY reason_code UNION ALL SELECT 'AS_OF', 'AS_OF', 0::bigint ) SELECT dimension, code, count, statement_timestamp() AS as_of FROM counts ORDER BY dimension, code
